sentences.text: No, the documents do not support a 4% foreclosure charge for this case; for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.
The case facts are a floating-rate loan to an individual for a non-business purpose, sanctioned on 2026-01-01, so paragraph 261(1) covers it.
The documents do not state any foreclosure charge amount for this case.
E1 states a 2% pre-payment charge in the home loan agreement, but E5 and R4 control this case and say no pre-payment charges shall be levied.
